title: Juice N Power Tropical Fruits 50ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Tropical Fruits tastes like a blissful island getaway, ripe with sun-soaked flavours like mango, pineapple and passionfruit. This convenient 50ml shortfill bottle comes with 10ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. Its 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , mods and sub-ohm tanks.
